name: captora
description: Captora — viral-style auto-captions. Web app + Remotion renderer + Electron desktop wrapper.

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --names "NEXT,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm --workspace electron run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron electron/dist/main.js"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.release: npm run build:all && electron-builder --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js

//build: electron-builder config lives in electron-builder.config.js — it branches on signing env vars, which a static JSON block can't do.
